scenes.summary: Just when the Cardiac Remediation Station is about to restart the Feranmut Heart, the pressure-distributing stabilizers runs into some problems that trigger an Aggelos attack. You decide to help neutralize this threat.

lines.text: Endmin, we can finally witness the restart of the Feranmut Heart.
Alright. Let's make use of the time and get started!
Protorig module activated. We also placed pressure-distributing stabilizers at various locations.
Should work this time...
Did something go wrong?
No, of course not. The Protorig is just more effective than we estimated. Our pressure-distributing stabilizers are a little overloaded!
I must find a way to stabilize the Heart!
We got your back!
Aggeloi? Why are they attracted to this?
At the moment of official restart, energy dissipation amplified by the Protorig module may have been too strong. Nearby surviving Aggeloid clusters must have caught on.
Endmin, the Aggeloi must be eliminated first...
Good. Aggeloid activity is most intense in ⟦key|forested areas⟧. We can go there first.
Initialization is done. Energy dissipation is stable. Endfield-modified Protorig module has been installed. Official restart of the Feranmut Heart is green to go.

options: I'm eager to see this happen.
We must keep this place safe.
The Tianshi will take care of the Feranmut Heart.

lines.text: Careful, sir!
Hey, what's wrong with these illusions...?
Looks like a Tianshi trying to protect a child.
Hey, I can sense rather familiar vibes from them.
Perhaps the Feranmut Heart's energy dissipation is affecting a Tianshi's data, and even recreated them.
These illusions seem to be replaying a certain scene. They have no will of their own.
Indeed. I'm glad these illusions don't pose a threat.
Hmm. Tianshi Han is toasting us.

options: Reminds me of the Marker Stone encounter...

lines.text: I'm also a mentor now! No retreat!
Hmm. This isn't like the previous illusion!
The illusions seem to portray Tianshi Ge in his younger days.
Wow. Did he look like this when he was younger?
It's alright. Anyone would've slipped... Your mentor also made mistakes before.
Wha, this feels like an actual Tianshi Ge!
Tianshi Ge has been stabilizing the Feranmut Heart all this time. Proximity and constant exposure to energy dissipation may have birthed these illusions.

scenes.summary: You help the injured Tianshi disciple repair the stabilizer. She asks you to return to the Cardiac Remediation Station and help the Tianshi.

lines.text: You repaired the stabilizers on time. We were so close to a major disaster. Thank you so much...
Things at the Lake Islet have settled down, at least for now.
Oh, the illusions just then...
I hope my mentor isn't affected.
We'll do that. But try to rest and tend to your injuries.
I knew it... I knew it was him.
Tianshi Ge is still trying to stabilize the Heart. But that illusion ... really looks like him.
I gotta work on the stabilizers. Please, help my mentor out!

options: Does this have to do with the Feranmut Heart?

scenes.summary: The Feranmut Heart is successfully repaired. Ge Yipu tells you about the illusions and uses the opportunity to elaborate his wish of passing on his torch. Everyone who helped repair the Heart has learned a great deal from this project.

lines.text: That was really close. Thank you all so much!
And the results are significantly stronger too. I guess great challenges give rise to great results.
We were so close to losing everything! I don't want another challenge like this.
Everything is worth it.
We worked with Endfield's latest Techno-Protocol and took part in Feranmut Heart repairs...
Got a feeling that Chang Yun is getting jealous right now.
Tianshi Han mentioned it... Illusions of me, right?
What did you exactly see?
I will never forget that incident. It made who I am today.
Haha. They just made me a mentor, so I paid no heed but to stand my ground. Truth is, I was just as terrified as well.
I know what my disciples really need.
However, giving them proper guidance and nurture ... is something that I've always wanted.
Thankfully, the young Tianshi have proved their worth. I feel rather pleased with myself.
As for the illusions... Endmin, just treat it as an interesting anomaly.
I shall readjust the Feranmut Heart's stabilizers.
Before we move the Heart back to the Marker Stone, it must stay here for a period of observation...
We must have a proper talk with Tianshi Zhuang. Perhaps our experience in Heart repairs can bring changes to Wuling City.
But ... regardless, if neither you nor Endfield was here, none of this would be achieved.
Endmin, thank you very much!
Now that I think about this, we have Tianshi Han's Imager, the device that successfully initialized the Feranmut Heart.
Then we have Tianshi Bu's Cardiograph. It found the audio frequencies for stabilizing the Heart's energy dissipation.
A spirit passed on through generations, helping each other in times of adversity. Such is the road treaded by the Wulingers.
Finally, we have a Protorig module improved by Endfield. We needed everything to complete the repairs. We upheld a ⟦key|legacy⟧.
This repair project is a valuable lesson learned for the three of us.

options: The Feranmut Heart seems to have stabilized.
I guess this is a ... successful restart?
A young man who stood up to face a challenge...
A Tianshi mentor with disciples of his own...

lines.text: Appreciate that. A short break is all I need.
The stabilizers must be repaired quickly to help my mentor stabilize the Feranmut Heart!
I'll keep the area safe. Please handle the additional problems for us.
Personnel safety is top priority! Be careful out there!
